messages:
maria: Hey team — we need to lock a time for a security design review of the payments-auth change. Main goals: threat modeling, privacy checklist, and an access review for the new service accounts. Prefer next Tue/Wed AM PT. Who's available?

jonathan: I can do Tue morning. Can we keep it to 45m? sounds like mostly design + 15m for open q's.

sara: Wed morning works better for me (timezone: CET). If we do Tue it needs to be after 11am my time.

kevin: I can run the threat model walkthrough — will prepare a short diagram + STRIDE notes. 45m seems fine.

maria: Great — kev, can you include the attacker surfaces for the auth flow? also add a quick note on token lifecycle.

kevin: yup. planning to include: 1) token issuance paths 2) refresh/rotation 3) delegated access rules.

jonathan: quick ask: can we add an item to confirm dashboard telemetry doesn't expose PII? would take 5m.

maria: yes — add to agenda. Also we should do an access recert for the service account perms as part of the review.

audit-bot: Security checklist: https://internal.redwood/audit/checklists/payments-auth. Pre-reads: please skim sections 2 (threats) and 5 (access controls).

maria: Pre-read request: everyone please review kevin's PR with the design doc: `github.com/redwood/pay-auth/pull/412` — comment by EOD Fri if possible.

scheduler-bot: Poll posted — respond with :thumbsup: for Tue 9am PT, :thumbsdown: for Wed 9am PT, :white_check_mark: if either works.

jonathan: :thumbsup: (Tue 9am PT works)

kevin: :white_check_mark: either is ok for me

sara: :thumbsdown: (Wed 9am PT only for me) — would it be possible to record?

maria: we'll record and capture notes. If we go Tue, sara we'll do a quick async catch-up after.

jonathan: Agenda draft (proposed):
```
- 0-5m: quick scope and goals (maria)
- 5-25m: threat model walkthrough (kevin)
- 25-35m: access review & recert plan (jonathan)
- 35-40m: telemetry / privacy check (maria)
- 40-45m: action items + owners
```

maria: sounds good. Anyone else to add?

kevin: can we also add a quick fallback plan item in case we need to roll back? 3m.

maria: added. final agenda will be attached to the calendar invite. I'll send invite once poll lands.

audit-bot: Required attendees flagged: Security (maria/kevin), Infra (jonathan), Privacy (sara). Optional: Product, Eng Oncall.

maria: Thanks all — please react to the poll and leave notes on the PR. I'll send calendar invite later today. :raised_hands:
